rule.name: Codex Discipline
rule.text: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

enhancements.name: Standard of the Emperor Ascendant
enhancements.text: ANCIENT model only. +1 OC and Ld, Feel No Pain 5+. Once per battle, when selected to fight, its melee attacks get +1 A until end of phase.

enhancements.name: Laurels of Triumph
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Melee attacks get +1 S and AP. If assault doctrine is active for the unit, +2 S and AP instead.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Codex
enhancements.text: CAPTAIN model only. Tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

enhancements.name: Artificer Armour

stratagems.effect: When a model is destroyed and the unit has not fought this phase, roll D6; on 4+ the model stays until the unit fights or the phase ends.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Melee attacks have [Lance].

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover].

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

rule.name: Assault Mastery

enhancements.name: Furious Assault

rule.name: Tactical Mastery

enhancements.name: Tactical Insight

enhancements.name: Master-forged Firearms

rule.name: Death Blow
rule.text: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR units have +1 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Champion of the First Company
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. Melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Corporeum Reliquary
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL DREADNOUGHT FORTITUDE
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: MERCILESS VETERANS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.

rule.name: Wrath of the Chapter

enhancements.name: Martial Paragon
enhancements.text: TACTICUS model only. Attacks can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll.

enhancements.name: Spearpoint War Leader

stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle], or [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit within range of an objective and eligible to fight.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagems.effect: It can move up to D3+3" when consolidating.

rule.name: Codex Fire-patterns
rule.text: Friendly TACTICUS units' [Rapid Fire] attacks get the Rapid Fire bonus against units up to the attack's maximum range.

enhancements.name: Cyber-familiar
enhancements.text: TACTICUS model only. After both armies deploy, redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units into strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.text: TACTICUS model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" can re-roll leadership rolls.

stratagems.name: FOR THE EMPEROR!
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit within range of an objective.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until end of turn.

stratagems.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle], or [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK BRUTALITY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged TACTICUS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks (excluding [Blast]) have [Close-Quarters] and [Ignores Cover].

rule.name: Shadow Masters
rule.text: After a friendly PHOBOS or SCOUT SQUAD unit shoots, either those attacks don't stop it being hidden, or it can make a normal move of up to D6" and cannot declare a charge this turn.

enhancements.name: Venator Omni-auspex
enhancements.text: PHOBOS model only. Attacks vs hidden units re-roll wound rolls of 1; if assault doctrine is active, re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2.

enhancements.name: Execute and Redeploy
enhancements.text: PHOBOS model only. After shooting, if unengaged, may make a normal move of up to 6"; it cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: STRIKE FROM THE SHADOWS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly hidden PHOBOS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have +1 S and [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.name: MORTIS SNARES
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: If it controls an objective, the objective is snared; when an enemy ends a move within range, roll D6, on 2+ it suffers D6 mortal wounds, then the snare ends.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL WITHDRAWAL
stratagems.when: End of opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

rule.text: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly PHOBOS unit is hidden, its attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until end of turn.

stratagems.name: UMBRAL EVASION
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly PHOBOS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks targeting your unit have -1 to hit.

rule.name: Walking Fortress
rule.text: In a turn a friendly GRAVIS unit made a normal move, its ranged attacks do not have [Heavy] and have +1 to hit.

enhancements.name: Relentless Advance
enhancements.text: GRAVIS model only. This unit has Scouts 5".

stratagems.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: If unengaged, make a normal move of up to 5" ending within range of an objective; it cannot declare a charge or embark this turn.

stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one engaged enemy unit; roll D6 per engaged model, each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit only (UPGRADE, 10 pts). Can re-roll advance rolls.

enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES SPEEDER unit only (UPGRADE, 10 pts). At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12"; it is spotted.

stratagems.name: WIND-SWIFT EVASION
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: If unengaged, make a normal move; if engaged, make a fall-back move.

stratagems.name: HURTLING TARGETS

stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks targeting your unit have -1 to hit.

stratagems.name: ADAMANTINE TERROR

stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll with -1.

stratagems.name: MERCY IS WEAKNESS

stratagems.effect: Attacks have [Lethal Hits], or [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.effect: Your unit has MOBILE.

rule.name: Combined Deployment
rule.text: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit; it is assailed until end of turn, and ADEPTUS ASTARTES units that disembarked this turn targeting it get [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only (20 pts). If it disembarked this turn, it can re-roll charge rolls and enemies cannot target it with snap shooting.

enhancements.name: Damocles-class Uplink
enhancements.text: CAPTAIN model only (15 pts). In your Movement phase, if embarked, select a friendly INFANTRY unit within 6" of the transport and one combat doctrine; that doctrine is active for it.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked in a TRANSPORT is selected to move.
stratagems.effect: While making that move, each model can be set up within the set-up distance of the TRANSPORT, not wholly within it.

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit eligible to fight, wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT and eligible to embark.
stratagems.effect: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit with an ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit embarked.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective it controls; it becomes secured.

enhancements.name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit only (excl. DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER) (UPGRADE, 25 pts). 5+ InSv; heals 1 wound at the end of your Command phase.

enhancements.name: Gunnery Honours
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit only (excl. DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER) (UPGRADE, 15 pts). Ranged attacks have [Heavy].

stratagems.name: LAYERED CERAMITE
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: MIGHT OF THE MACHINE SPIRIT
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excl. DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER).
stratagems.effect: Until your next Command phase, ignore modifiers to M, BS, hit rolls and wound rolls.

stratagems.name: HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit (excl. DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER) is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

enhancements.text: CRUSADER SQUAD unit only (UPGRADE, 15 pts). Can re-roll Advance rolls.

enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit only (10 pts). Advance or fall-back moves do not stop it starting an action.

stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit with S greater than its T have -1 to wound.

stratagems.effect: Melee attacks have [Lethal Hits], or [Sustained Hits 1].

rule.name: Faith-fuelled Resolve
rule.text: In the Fight phase, if a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD is within range of an objective, its melee attacks have +1 A. Army may include only BLACK TEMPLARS ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

enhancements.name: Fervent Exemplars
enhancements.text: SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit only (UPGRADE, 10 pts). +1 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Inheritors of Sigismund
enhancements.text: SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit only (UPGRADE, 15 pts). Fights First.

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effect: Melee attacks targeting a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.

stratagems.name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when a unit engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD is selected to fall back.
stratagems.effect: The enemy unit must use desperate escape, with -1 to hazard rolls if battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.effect: Select one engaged enemy unit; roll D6 per engaged model, each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound (max 6).

rule.name: Templar Vows
rule.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one Vow, active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units until end of battle: Abhor the Witch, Accept Any Challenge, or Uphold the Honour of the Emperor. Army may include only BLACK TEMPLARS ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only (20 pts). In your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 18"; it cannot benefit from cover.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.text: At the start of each battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Space Marine Chapters
armyRules.text: An ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit with a second Faction keyword is from that Chapter. Your army cannot include units from more than one Chapter.

armyRules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
armyRules.text: Your army cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER models, or the Codex: Space Marines datasheets Gladiator Lancer, Gladiator Reaper, Gladiator Valiant, Impulsor, Repulsor and Repulsor Executioner.

rule.text: Select assault or tactical doctrine one extra time per battle. ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER units: +1 to advance rolls. enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.target: One friendly THE SANGUINOR or unengaged JUMP PACK unit
stratagems.effect: Place the unit in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: In the Shadow of Great Wings
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit
stratagems.effect: It has Stealth and a -3" detection range.

rule.name: Wrath of Angels
rule.text: The tactical doctrine is active for SANGUINARY GUARD units in addition to any other combat doctrine.

enhancements.name: Shadow of Abomination
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. Once per battle, when selected to fight, the bearer's melee attacks get +1 Damage.

enhancements.name: Angelic Executioner
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. When selected to fight, the bearer's unit's melee attacks have LETHAL HITS or SUSTAINED HITS 1.

stratagems.name: Judgement of the Golden Host
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a charge move
stratagems.effect: Select one engaged enemy unit. Roll a D6 per engaged model in your unit. Each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: Inexorable Valour
stratagems.when: Opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a Fall Back move and your unit is now unengaged
stratagems.effect: It can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Blinding Blurs of Vengeance
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit
stratagems.effect: It has Stealth and a -3" detection range.

rule.name: Sanguinius' Fury
rule.text: Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the assault doctrine active at the start of each phase. The devastator and tactical doctrines cannot be active for them.

stratagems.name: Death Begets Vengeance
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is destroyed by an enemy unit
stratagems.effect: It is Hated until end of battle: friendly DEATH COMPANY attacks targeting it get +1 to wound.

stratagems.name: No Barrier to Retribution
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly DEATH COMPANY DREADNOUGHT is selected to move or declare a charge
stratagems.effect: It has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Rage-fuelled Response
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DEATH COMPANY unit has shot
stratagems.effect: It can make a surge move of up to D6".

rule.name: Black-winged Vigilance
rule.text: Friendly RAVENWING FLY units' ranged attacks have IGNORES COVER. Friendly OUTRIDER SQUAD units have BATTLELINE.

enhancements.name: Thundercowl Turbines
enhancements.text: RAVENWING FLY or MOUNTED unit only. In your first Movement phase, the bearer's unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Nightforged Battery
enhancements.text: LAND SPEEDER VENGEANCE unit only. The bearer's unit can re-roll rolls to determine a weapon's Attacks, and Hazard rolls.

stratagems.name: Skyborne Surveillance
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly RAVENWING FLY unit has shot
stratagems.effect: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit get +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: We Are Vengeance
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged RAVENWING FLY unit has shot
stratagems.effect: It can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: Wings of Shadow
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly RAVENWING FLY or MOUNTED unit
stratagems.effect: It has Stealth.

rule.name: Vowed Target
rule.text: In your Command phase, you may select one objective as your vowed objective until your next Command phase. Friendly DEATHWING INFANTRY attacks that target an enemy unit within range of it get +1 to wound.

enhancements.name: Singular Will
enhancements.text: DEATHWING model only. When the bearer's unit is selected to make a Consolidation move, it can move up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Champion of the Deathwing
enhancements.text: DEATHWING model only. The bearer's unit's attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have SUSTAINED HITS 1.

stratagems.name: Duty Unto Death
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly DEATHWING unit
stratagems.effect: When a model is destroyed and the unit hasn't fought this phase, roll a D6 (+1 if engaged with an enemy within range of the vowed objective): on 4+ the model stays until the unit has fought or the phase ends.

stratagems.name: Relic Teleportarium
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit with Deep Strike is selected to make an ingress move
stratagems.effect: It can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemies (instead of 8"), but cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Wrath of the Lion
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly DEATHWING unit ends a charge move
stratagems.effect: Select one engaged enemy unit. Roll a D6 per engaged model; each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal wound, to a maximum of 6.

rule.name: Dutiful Tenacity
rule.text: Attacks targeting friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED units with Strength greater than that unit's Toughness get -1 to wound.

enhancements.name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" can re-roll Leadership rolls.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Ravenwing
enhancements.text: RAVENWING model only. The bearer's unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.text: DEATHWING model with Deep Strike only. In your first Movement phase, the bearer's unit can make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: In Sacrifice, Victory
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly DEATHWING or RAVENWING unit within range of an objective is destroyed
stratagems.target: That destroyed unit (you can still target it)
stratagems.effect: Pick an objective: either one with no enemy non-AIRCRAFT units in range, or one your unit controlled at the end of the previous phase. It becomes secured.

stratagems.name: Lion's Will
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within range of an objective
stratagems.effect: +1 OC until end of turn.

stratagems.name: Inescapable Justice
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Its melee attacks have PRECISION.

stratagems.name: Tactical Mastery
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.target: One friendly DEATHWING or RAVENWING unit
stratagems.effect: Pick one combat doctrine; it stays active for that unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Knights of Iron
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly RAVENWING unit is selected to move or declares a charge
stratagems.effect: It has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Relics of the Dark Age
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks get +2 Strength.

rule.name: The Great Wolf Watches
rule.text: Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER units have Countercharge: once per battle round per unit, when you target that unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, that use costs 1CP less.

enhancements.name: Preyslayer
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. The bearer's unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

enhancements.name: A Giant Amongst Giants
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. The bearer has +2 Wounds and its melee attacks get +1 Strength.

stratagems.name: Champion's Guidance
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Its melee attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Heroic Resolve
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting it get -1 Damage until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Birth of a Saga
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE)
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, it has the CHARACTER keyword.

rule.name: Legendary Slayers
rule.text: Attacks made by friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY and WULFEN units have LETHAL HITS against CHARACTER, MONSTER and VEHICLE targets.

enhancements.name: Hunter's Guile
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed, redeploy up to three friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN units into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already there.

enhancements.name: Wolf-Touched
enhancements.text: WULFEN WITH STORM SHIELDS or WULFEN leader. ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer's unit gains the WULFEN keyword and +2" Move.

stratagems.name: Unbridled Feroicity
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Its melee attacks have LANCE.

stratagems.name: Co-ordinated Strike
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase
stratagems.target: One unengaged BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN unit within 9" of one or more battlefield edges
stratagems.effect: Place that unit in Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Impetuosity
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged BLOOD CLAWS, THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY or WULFEN unit has shot
stratagems.effect: It can make a surge move of up to D6".

rule.name: Master of Wolves
rule.text: Howling Onslaught. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE) gain: Encircling Jaws (assault doctrine active: +1 to Advance and Charge rolls); Hunter's Eye (devastator doctrine active: ranged attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1); Ferocious Strike (tactical doctrine active: attacks against enemy units within 9" have SUSTAINED HITS 1). Friendly LOGAN GRIMNAR units: once per battle, in your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MONSTER and VEHICLE units gain Master of Wolves until your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Howlmaw
enhancements.text: WOLF PRIEST model only. Once per turn per unit, at the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within 6"; it takes a Battle-shock test at -1.

enhancements.name: Grimnar's Mark
enhancements.text: TERMINATOR CAPTAIN model only. Once per battle round per army, the bearer's unit can be targeted with Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention regardless of other uses that phase, and that use costs 1CP less.

stratagems.name: Eye of the Pack
stratagems.when: Your Shooting or Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack
stratagems.effect: Its attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and 2.

stratagems.name: Wolf Totems
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit suffers a mortal wound
stratagems.effect: It has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Fangs of the Pack
stratagems.when: Your Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit is selected to fight
stratagems.effect: Its melee attacks have PRECISION.

stratagems.name: Fenrisian Ferocity
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED or WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge
stratagems.effect: It has MOBILE.

stratagems.name: Grimnar's Command
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE)
stratagems.effect: Select one combat doctrine, active for it until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Battle Instincts
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit has shot
stratagems.effect: It makes a Normal move of up to D3+3".

rule.name: Mission Tactics
rule.text: KILL TEAM units with this ability gain three tactics. Furor: if the devastator doctrine is active, their attacks have SUSTAINED HITS 1. Malleus: if the tactical doctrine is active, their attacks have LETHAL HITS. Purgatus: if the assault doctrine is active, their attacks that target enemy units within 9" have PRECISION.

enhancements.name: The Thief of Secrets
enhancements.text: WATCH MASTER or CAPTAIN only. Grants a melee weapon: A6, WS 2+, S6, AP-3, D2.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model. If it is a KILL TEAM unit, it has Deep Strike. Targeting it with Rapid Ingress costs 1CP more.

enhancements.name: The Tome of Ectoclades
enhancements.text: WATCH MASTER or CAPTAIN only. Once per battle, in your Command phase, the assault, devastator and tactical doctrines are all active for the bearer's unit until your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Osseus Key (Aura)
enhancements.text: WATCH MASTER or TECHMARINE only. While an enemy VEHICLE unit is within 6" of the bearer, that enemy's attacks get -1 Attacks.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit
stratagems.effect: Attacks targeting your unit get -1 Armour Penetration until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Kraken Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks get +6" Range and +1 Strength.

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks (except DEVASTATING WOUNDS) have ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+.

stratagems.name: Dragonfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and have IGNORES COVER.

stratagems.name: Adaptive Tactics
stratagems.when: Your Command phase
stratagems.effect: Select one combat doctrine to be active for that unit until your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Site-to-site Teleportation
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit
stratagems.effect: Place it in Strategic Reserves. If it has KILL TEAM, it gains Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks get +6" Range and +1 Strength.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and have IGNORES COVER.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot
stratagems.effect: Its ranged attacks (except DEVASTATING WOUNDS) have ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit
stratagems.effect: Place it in Strategic Reserves.

armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.text: At the start of your Command phase, choose one doctrine (Assault, Devastator or Tactical). It stays active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until your next Command phase. Each doctrine can normally be chosen once per battle, and a unit can only have one active at a time. Assault: a unit that Advances can still declare a charge. Devastator: ranged weapons have ASSAULT. Tactical: a unit that Falls Back can still shoot and declare a charge.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.text: At the start of each battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, you gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Librarius
armyRules.text: PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level, and each psychic ability has a psychic level. In a battle round, a unit can use psychic abilities whose total psychic level doesn't exceed its psyker level.

armyRules.name: Special Move Types
armyRules.text: Shock Disembark lets embarked units set up within 3" of their transport if they didn't embark that phase, but they can't charge that turn. Assault Disembark works the same way, but only if the transport didn't Advance or Fall Back that phase.

armyRules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
armyRules.text: Black Templars. Your army can't include PSYKER models or Gladiator Lancer, Gladiator Reaper, Gladiator Valiant, Impulsor, Repulsor or Repulsor Executioner units.

armyRules.name: The Ravenwing
armyRules.text: Dark Angels. MOUNTED units and VEHICLE FLY units gain the RAVENWING keyword.

armyRules.name: The Deathwing
armyRules.text: Dark Angels. TERMINATOR units, Bladeguard Ancient and Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs, Land Raider variants, Repulsor, Repulsor Executioner and DREADNOUGHT units gain the DEATHWING keyword.

armyRules.name: Veteran Recruits
armyRules.text: Deathwatch. Your army can't include Scout Squad, Terminator Squad or Terminator Assault Squad units.

armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.text: At the start of your Command phase, choose one doctrine (Assault, Devastator or Tactical). It stays active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until your next Command phase. Each doctrine can normally be chosen once per battle, and a unit can only have one active at a time. Assault: a unit that Advances can still declare a charge. Devastator: ranged weapons have ASSAULT. Tactical: a unit that Falls Back can still shoot and declare a charge.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.text: At the start of each battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, you gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Librarius
armyRules.text: PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level, and each psychic ability has a psychic level. In a battle round, a unit can use psychic abilities whose total psychic level doesn't exceed its psyker level.

armyRules.name: Special Move Types
armyRules.text: Shock Disembark lets embarked units set up within 3" of their transport if they didn't embark that phase, but they can't charge that turn. Assault Disembark works the same way, but only if the transport didn't Advance or Fall Back that phase.

armyRules.name: Heirs of Sigismund
armyRules.text: Black Templars. Your army can't include PSYKER models or Gladiator Lancer, Gladiator Reaper, Gladiator Valiant, Impulsor, Repulsor or Repulsor Executioner units.

armyRules.name: The Ravenwing
armyRules.text: Dark Angels. MOUNTED units and VEHICLE FLY units gain the RAVENWING keyword.

armyRules.name: The Deathwing
armyRules.text: Dark Angels. TERMINATOR units, Bladeguard Ancient and Veteran Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, Vanguard Veteran Squad with Jump Packs, Land Raider variants, Repulsor, Repulsor Executioner and DREADNOUGHT units gain the DEATHWING keyword.
